content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean in closer, fingers brushing against his wrist ||| “Let them watch us unravel this together.”  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing his wrist from my grip ||| “I can't answer while they’re all watching.”  
CONFESSION ||| Hold his gaze, letting my breath steady ||| “I feel lost without you here beside me.”  
REVERSAL ||| Take the blade from his hand, claiming it ||| “I’ll determine what’s asked, Julian, not you.”  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, heart racing, absorbing the tension ||| *A breath escapes, heavy and unsteady.*
